title: Handbook
intro: How you work, from the customer having a need to a satisfied customer. Click a process to see its steps, who does what, and the procedures you follow.

core.eyebrow: Core processes · what you live from

map.footnote: The dots show whether something needs attention: green is fine, yellow has something due soon, and red has an open deviation or a procedure that is out of date.
map.orderHint: Put the processes in the order the work flows. Core processes read from left to right.
map.orderFailed: Could not save the order. Try again.

empty.title: You have not made the process map yet
empty.body: The process map shows how the company works, from the customer having a need to a satisfied customer. Get a suggestion from the company profile, or make the first process yourself.

procedures.intro: All procedures, instructions and checklists, grouped by process.
procedures.empty: No procedures yet. Make the first one with “+ New procedure”.

waiting.intro: Procedures waiting for you to approve them or confirm that you have read them.
waiting.empty: Nothing is waiting for you now.

process.noStepsBody: Draw the steps of the process, who does them and which procedure they follow.
process.notFound: Could not find the process. It may have been deleted, or you do not have access.

cards.proceduresEmpty: No procedures are linked to the process yet.
cards.whoEmpty: Add the roles to the steps so everyone sees who does what.
cards.risksEmpty: No risks are linked to the process yet.

ask.prompt: Explain the process “{{ title }}”: the steps, who does what and which procedures we follow.
